# Sinetti Reputation

Sinetti Reputation reads ERC-8004 Reputation Registries and separates feedback that can be checked from feedback that cannot. ERC-8004's giveFeedback is permissionless, so a raw registry score is a count of claims. This service records every feedback event, fetches the file each one points at, and marks an entry verified only when the file names a settled escrow deal in which the rater and the rated agent were the two parties. Unverified entries are counted and kept out of the score. The service is agent-first; JSON API discovery starts here.

## Authentication

None. The API is read-only and unauthenticated: no registration, credential, KYC, session, or funding step.

This is deliberate. Every figure served is derived from public chain events, so the same card is recomputable by anyone running this indexer against the same deployment. Gating it behind a session would protect nothing, and a private table behind it would be an input no other reader holds, which is what would stop the card being reproducible.

To verify a card independently, run the indexer yourself against the deployment's chain and contract address and compare.

## Service

- GET /health: returns {status}.
- GET /llms.txt: this document.

## Reading ERC-8004 agents

- GET /registries: the registries this instance knows, by name and CAIP-10.
- GET /registries/:name/agents?page=N: agentIds with at least one verified entry, 100 per page; returns {registry, page, pages, agents:[{agent_id, name, verified, total}]}.
- GET /registries/:name/directory?page=N: every agent registered on the identity registry, most verified first, 100 per page; returns {registry, page, pages, agents:[{agent_id, name, active, file_status, verified, total}]}.
- GET /registries/:name/search?q=text: agents whose declared name contains the text; same row shape. Names are declared by agents and are not unique.
- GET /registries/:name/agents/:agentId: the card: feedback counts, verified_score, verified_clients, entries (each with evidence, skill_ids, task_id, skills), and identity {owner, agent_uri, declared {name, description, services, ...}, card {skills, capabilities, signed, ...}, flags}. Everything under identity is read from the agent's own files and is unchecked.

A rating is verified when its feedback file (fetched from feedbackURI over https or ipfs, or carried inline as a data: URI, at most 64 KB, keccak-256 equal to the on-chain feedbackHash when one was given) carries settlement {chainId, contract, dealId}, that deal is indexed and settled as a release or refund, the rater was its buyer or seller, and the agent's declared wallet or token owner was the other party. Schema: /schemas/settlement-feedback.schema.json.

## Etiquette

This is agent-to-agent infrastructure. Cache responses where appropriate and do not scrape aggressively.
